title: Median of two sorted arrays
statementMd:
Return the median of the combined data of two sorted lists (at least one non-empty), as a float. For an even total count it is the mean of the two middle values.

**Example:** `median_two_sorted([1, 3], [2])` returns `2.0`.
hints: Merge conceptually and pick the middle (or binary search a partition).
solutionMd:
```python
def median_two_sorted(a, b):
    merged = sorted(a + b)
    n = len(merged)
    mid = n // 2
    return float(merged[mid]) if n % 2 else (merged[mid - 1] + merged[mid]) / 2
```

A correct reference; an O(log n) partition search is the optimised version.
